acceptance_predicates.description: All `asb` subcommands and command-line options are extracted from the authoritative CLI definition, including setup, project, tool, config, plan, run, sweep, recording, replay, report, compare, and diagnostics.
Each option and command is linked to the entities it creates, reads, updates, validates, launches, or emits, using the AR-1844/1845 registry rather than a parallel hand-written map.
The extracted relations preserve lifecycle ordering from initial system/project configuration through execution and benchmark results, including conditional branches and failure/remediation paths.

definition_of_done: ASB can emit a complete command/option-to-entity relation inventory for the full CLI workflow.

inputs.description: Authoritative clap/command definitions and execution dispatch.

outputs.description: Versioned machine-readable command, option, entity, and lifecycle relation graph input.

gates.description: Command/option coverage test matches the authoritative ASB CLI definition and relation fixtures cover the end-to-end workflow.
